objective: Bring Joseph's Key to Joseph's Chest.

description: Daddy told me to give you this key.  He said it opens a chest out back behind the house.
He also wanted me to thank you.  Did you do a favor for him?  Did you tell him you found my doll?
Well here's the key.  And thank you <name>.  Thank you!  You're a very nice man/lady!
progress: This chest is old and covered in grime.
completion: The key fits the lock, and the chest opens...
